spec.hypothesis: Every series with nonzero relative_q80 (>=0.001) is an H100 series, and these are the volatile, frequently repricing ones. Always-narrow beats medium on marketplace H100 (0.0560 vs 0.0616) and on neocloud H100_80GB (0.01261 vs 0.01362). It loses a little on H100_SXM, which only partly meets the threshold. The marketplace-only edit and the relative_q80>=0.1 edit passed development but were flat at checkpoint. This wider threshold adds the second H100 gain of the same sign. It is a per-decision volatility test on one numeric feature, so it should be programmable, unlike the multi-class gpu_model and unchanged_fraction tests. Promote narrow.
